summary: Master Community Benefit Agreements for extractive industries with practical tools for negotiation, drafting, tracking, and reporting. Enroll today.
lede: Community benefit agreements for extractive industries set out negotiated commitments around mining, oil, gas and related projects. For community relations, social performance, local content, CSR and legal professionals, the course addresses converting consultation findings into commitments that can be signed, funded and monitored. Participants practice stakeholder and needs mapping, negotiation planning, clause drafting, implementation tracking and monitoring dashboards, with overview-level coverage of dispute resolution, governance and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals working at the intersection of extractive operations, community relations, legal review, and social performance delivery.
modules: Community Benefit Agreements and Social Licence
prerequisites: Bring a laptop for template work and document editing. If possible, prepare an anonymized community agreement, consultation summary, grievance log, or benefit-tracking sheet from your current or recent project.
